options.name: asp_group
options.description: Specifies the name of the auxiliary storage pool (ASP) group to set for the current thread. The ASP group name is the name of the primary ASP device within the ASP group.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: format
options.description: The save file's format. Only support C(*SAVF) by now.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the avaiable JOBLOG even the rc is 0(success).

options.name: object_lib
options.description: The library that contains the saved objects.

options.name: object_names
options.description: The objects need to be restored. One or more object names can be specified. Use space as separator.

options.name: object_types
options.description: The object types. One or more object types can be specified. Use space as separator.

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters that RSTOBJ command will take. Other than options above, all other parameters need to be specified here. The default values of parameters for RSTOBJ will be taken if not specified.
